text: Already handled: 'standby' was only a label. Kalshi and Polymarket feed lines from memory/sockets with no counted fetch, so the scorecard showed them idle. Fixed (ApiScorecard, tests green) and ships with the next release. All three (Kalshi, Polymarket, SX Bet) are in the fair-odds source list. The real gap is matching: only ~7-8 events matched each, mostly because props don't map (CH8/CH9). That mapping fix and a per-bet feed chip are next on my list.
